trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(d:Document), (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team) WHERE p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] AND (((t.team_name <> 'Houston Rockets') AND (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 2)) OR ((CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) <> 1949) AND (CAST(t.championships AS INT64) <> 1))) RETURN p.position AS col1, SUM(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)) AS col2
